candidates.title: Count and track deletions
candidates.statement: The system shall count and track record deletions (for example item records and patron records) per location and per system.
candidates.source_quote: We need to be able to count and track record deletions (item records, patron records) per location and per system.

candidates.title: Persist deletion audit entries
candidates.statement: The system shall record deletion events in an audit log so that deleted records do not disappear without a trace.
candidates.source_quote: Right now when something gets deleted, it just... disappears. No record.
candidates.priority_signals: This is actually a good idea from an auditing standpoint.

candidates.title: Database trigger for deletions
candidates.statement: The system shall implement a database trigger that logs deletions to a deletion audit table.
candidates.source_quote: A trigger in the database that logs deletions to an audit table
candidates.priority_signals: Robert will implement the database triggers.

candidates.title: Deletion audit table fields
candidates.statement: The system shall store deletion audit records with fields: record_type, record_id, deleted_by, deleted_at, and location.
candidates.source_quote: Fields: record_type, record_id, deleted_by, deleted_at, location
candidates.priority_signals: Listed as required fields for the audit table

candidates.title: Record pre-deletion status/reason
candidates.statement: The system shall (optionally) record the status before deletion or a reason for the deletion in the deletion audit record.
candidates.priority_signals: raised as a possibly useful field

candidates.title: Report interface for deletion audit
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a report interface that can query the deletion audit table and present results to users.
candidates.source_quote: A report interface to query this audit table
candidates.priority_signals: Katherine will draft the report interface requirements.

candidates.title: Deletion reporting and aggregation
candidates.statement: The system shall provide reports that show total deletions per period (month, quarter, year), deletions by type (item, patron, other), deletions by location, top users who delete the most records, and shall allow aggregation and filtering by date range, by user, and by record type; reports shall be available per system and per location.
candidates.source_quote: The report should show deletions per location and per system. We can aggregate by date range, by user, by record type. ... Total deletions per period ... Deletions by type ... Deletions by location ... Top users
candidates.stakeholder: Susan Sexton-Cooley / George Tuttle / Robert Chen / Katherine Gregory
candidates.priority_signals: helps with compliance; "absolutely need this"; administrative requirement

candidates.title: Log denied deletion attempts
candidates.statement: The system shall log attempted deletion actions that were denied, including the attempted actor and timestamp, to support compliance and troubleshooting.
candidates.source_quote: Can we also track attempted deletions that were denied?
candidates.priority_signals: helpful for compliance and troubleshooting; included in consolidated requirement

candidates.title: Trace deletion of a specific record
candidates.statement: The system shall allow users to retrieve audit entries for a specific record_id so administrators can trace who deleted a specific record and when.
candidates.source_quote: If we accidentally delete something we shouldn't have, we need to be able to trace it.
